label: Empty join elements suppress their separator
rationale: An empty payload is still an element. Skipping its separator during chunk optimization changes emitted text and list position.
before: case Con{h, t}: nt_join_chunks(t, sep, False{}, Con{h, Con{nt_choose(String, first, u => "", u => sep), acc}})
after: case Con{h, t}: nt_join_chunks(t, sep, False{}, Con{h, Con{nt_choose(String, first || String.eq(h, ""), u => "", u => sep), acc}})
expectedBehavior: An empty payload is still an element. Skipping its separator during chunk optimization changes emitted text and list position.
